text: 🇲🇽⚽ Mexico 3, Czechia 0. The host nation is dancing. "Congratulations to the National Team. This is a video from yesterday — the celebration." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Mexico opened the conference with the squad's 3-0 win and footage of fans celebrating in plazas from Tamaulipas onward. Mexico co-hosts the 2026 World Cup with the US and Canada.

🇲🇽🌎 Colombia elected a hard-right president. Mexico's answer: we'll congratulate him. "We'll congratulate Colombia's president-elect, and we always seek a good relationship regardless of whether we agree on certain issues. We seek good relations with all governments." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Right-wing candidate Abelardo de la Espriella won Colombia's presidency. Mexico's response follows its constitutional doctrine: non-intervention, self-determination, and cooperation with every government a people chooses.

🔥🇲🇽 "International right-wing groups organize to flood social media with fake news. That has to be reviewed in Mexico." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Asked about coordinated disinformation, the president pointed to organized international right-wing networks weaponizing social media with fabricated content — and tied it to the importance of the reforms her government has put forward.

🇲🇽🎨 700,000 young people. 4,785 plazas. One day of murals across all 32 states. "We're launching the National Day of Murals across the 32 states of the republic — in 4,785 plazas, the youth are painting." — Abraham Carro, Mexican Youth Institute Over 700,000 young Mexicans took to public squares to paint, reclaiming the muralist tradition as living, communal art. Civic life and recreation in the same brushstroke.

🇲🇽🚆 The first Mexican-built passenger train ships July 25. The beams are forged at home. "The Mexico City–Pachuca line is 37% complete: 58 kilometers, double-tracked, electrified and protected." — Cmdr. Ricardo Vallejo Suárez, Felipe Ángeles Engineer Corps Four corridors under construction by military engineers. 15 trains for AIFA–Pachuca, first unit shipping July 25; 47 diesel-electric trains for the northern lines by 2027. The viaduct beams are fabricated in Mexico. 33,072 Defense workers on the job — reviving the passenger rail buried by 1990s privatization.

🇲🇽🌎 Venezuela was hit by two earthquakes. Mexico's rescuers were on a plane the same day. "Our solidarity with the people of Venezuela. Today a team from the Ministry of National Defense — rescuers and medical personnel — departs for Venezuela." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Two quakes, magnitude 7.2 and 7.5, struck Venezuela on June 24. Mexico dispatched a SEDENA team of rescuers and medics the next morning, with more to follow as needed. Solidarity, no conditions attached.

🚨🇲🇽 52 dead in ICE custody. Mexico is sending diplomatic notes — and taking the cases to the Inter-American Commission. "There are issues where we don't agree. One of them, which worries us and occupies us, is the death of Mexicans in ICE detention centers. We've been raising it with the ambassador and sending the diplomatic notes required." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Human Rights Watch and Physicians for Human Rights count 52 deaths in ICE custody under Trump's second term — a 140% jump in the death rate. Mexico's consuls were ordered to review detention conditions; the cases are headed to the CIDH.

🇲🇽💵 TRUMP BET ON FEAR. MEXICAN MIGRANTS SENT MORE MONEY ANYWAY

Despite deportation raids and a proposed US tax on transfers, remittances to Mexico rose 2.6% over the first four months of 2026, per Banxico — $14.166 billion in the first quarter alone, up from $13.966 billion a year earlier. April pulled in $4.978 billion, +3.7% year-on-year. Washington keeps trying to weaponize the people who do its hardest work; the lifeline they send home only got bigger.
